description: Figure 4.1 presents a series of line plots illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model across different configurations. The overall figure is composed of five subplots, each corresponding to a different model size and weight configuration, as indicated by the title of each subplot. The x-axis in all subplots is labeled "epoch" and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and represents the Word Error Rate, with values ranging from 10 to 70, depending on the subplot. The plots are organized into two rows: the top row contains three plots for "type = tiny", "type = base", and "type = small", while the bottom row contains two plots for "type = medium" and "type = large". Each subplot displays multiple lines, each representing a different fine-tuning configuration (e.g., "tiny AdaLoRA_int4", "tiny int4", "tiny full"). The lines are distinguished by their color, marker shape, and line style, with a legend provided in each subplot to identify the corresponding configuration. The data shows the WER evolving over the course of six epochs for each configuration, with the specific values and trends varying across the different model types and fine-tuning methods.
